missing: Every official start list and result for this meeting was a PDF on www.icf-thun2009.ch/images/stories/files/; the organiser site is offline and none of those PDFs is in the Wayback Machine (https). No boat, bib, name, heat or rank can be taken from an official source, so the sheet has no rows.
Paddle Worldwide (https://paddleworldwide.com/disciplines/canoe-freestyle/results) lists no 2009 freestyle results.

Non-official copies exist and were NOT used: https://bayak.com/results/worldwide/1448-icf-freestyle-world-championships-results (rank, bib, name, total, round reached, NOC per class), https://results.quko.es (aggregator), federation blog summaries (cnawr.cz, russianfreestyle.blogspot.com).
